e.title: insurance-spatial
e.summary: 空间领土费率（burning-cost，PyPI 0.2.4）：BYM2 空间费率厘定 + conformal 预测区间，英国个人险
e.summary_en: Spatial territory ratemaking (burning-cost, PyPI 0.2.4): BYM2 spatial ratemaking + conformal prediction intervals, UK personal lines
e.summary_hk: 空間領土費率（burning-cost，PyPI 0.2.4）：BYM2 空間費率釐定 + conformal 預測區間，英國個人險
e.body: insurance-spatial（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.4）做空间领土费率厘定：BYM2 空间随机效应模型（地理相邻结构平滑费率）、空间 conformal 预测区间——英国个人险。对 RIAA：领土因子是车险/家财险定价的核心维度——空间平滑（而非独立后验）是行业前沿（相邻区域费率应连续）；BYM2 是贝叶斯空间建模标准（[[insurance-gam]] 之外的另一个方向）；与 [[insurance-nested-glm]]（嵌入聚类）、[[insurance-conformal]]（预测区间）配套。
e.body_en: insurance-spatial (burning-cost, PyPI v0.2.4) does spatial territory ratemaking: BYM2 spatial random effects (smoothing rates over geographic adjacency), spatial conformal prediction intervals — UK personal lines. For RIAA: territory factors are core to auto/home pricing — spatial smoothing (rather than independent posteriors) is the frontier (neighbouring regions should have continuous rates); BYM2 is the Bayesian spatial modelling standard (another direction beyond [[insurance-gam]]); pairs with [[insurance-nested-glm]] (embedding clustering) and [[insurance-conformal]] (prediction intervals).
e.body_hk: insurance-spatial（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.4）做空間領土費率釐定：BYM2 空間隨機效應模型（地理相鄰結構平滑費率）、空間 conformal 預測區間——英國個人險。對 RIAA：領土因子是車險/家財險定價的核心維度——空間平滑（而非獨立後驗）是行業前沿（相鄰區域費率應連續）；BYM2 是貝葉斯空間建模標準（[[insurance-gam]] 之外的另一個方向）；與 [[insurance-nested-glm]]（嵌入聚類）、[[insurance-conformal]]（預測區間）配套。
